user.title: Cat Facts
user.description: Configure Cat Facts. The integration will fetch cat facts from the given JSON URL and update the sensor every configured number of hours.

data_description.json_url: URL to a JSON file containing a list of facts, or an object with a 'facts' key.
data_description.random: Pick a random fact on each update. Disable for sequential order.
data_description.update_interval: How many hours between each new fact (1–168).
